title: suggest_band 500 still reproduces — Lane 4 added composite in wrong sort direction
summary: Query at roster.ts:747-749 uses .where('status','==',X).orderBy('assignedAt','desc'). firestore.indexes.json (origin/master, edb24a47c) has scheduling_assignments(status ASCENDING, assignedAt ASCENDING) — should be DESCENDING. Firestore FAILED_PRECONDITION URL decodes to 'status ASC, assignedAt DESC, __name__ DESC'. Even the operator hint in roster.ts:847 repeats the wrong direction. The original cycle-7 REPRO-C7I1-004 bug is still present at edb24a47c.
evidence: tools/call suggest_band {setlistId:'UnjLqKTtS4lNKQfMY6hB'} returns 500 + 9 FAILED_PRECONDITION at prod
patch: Flip assignedAt to DESCENDING in firestore.indexes.json; firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes; update roster.ts:847 hint string. Also confirm Lane 4 actually deployed (not just committed JSON).

title: chart-bond cron per-setlist breach formula (okCount/trackCount) fires on every typical Shabbat service
summary: Emor setlist has bondedCount:14, okCount:13, missingCount:1 — bonds 92.9% healthy. The cron's formula okCount/trackCount with trackCount=30 (16 intentional unbonded section markers) returns 43.3% — under the 70% breach threshold. Every typical service with many section markers triggers an alert that doesn't correspond to a real chart-bond problem.
evidence: verify_setlist_charts on UnjLqKTtS4lNKQfMY6hB returns trackCount:30 bondedCount:14 okCount:13
patch: Switch denominator to bondedCount; add bondedCount>=3 floor.
